newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU farmers say reform plans "unacceptable".
newsitem.headline: EU farmers say reform plans "unacceptable".

text.p: European farmers on Wednesday attacked draft plans to cut farm support as part of preparations for EU expansion eastwards early next century.

"Agriculture proposals unacceptable for European agriculture and for the future and existence of European farmers," Luc Guyau President of the European Union's farmers' organisation, COPA, said in a statement.

European Commission President Jacques Santer is expected to present reform proposals, which include cuts in milk, cereals and beef support prices of between 10 and 30 percent, next Wednesday. Farmers would be only partially compensated.
In a cable to the EU's 20 commissioners, Guyau warned that COPA leaders meeting on Thursday and Friday will assume their "responsibility to save agriculture from this aggression".
